peers.name: browser-mcp-agent
peers.description: Give an AI agent its own real browser over MCP tool calls - launch, navigate, click, fill, screenshot, extract text, run JS - with a kernel-level real-device fingerprint and a persistent profile, so the session stays logged in between runs and pages see one coherent device instead of a headless build. No Playwright or SDK code to write. Use when an agent should operate a site itself, when a computer-use / browser-use setup needs a captured real fingerprint rather than a synthetic one, when agent sessions keep losing their login, or when comparing hosted agent-browser services. Also for 'MCP browser', 'browser MCP server', 'let my agent browse the web', 'agent browser control', 'browser-use MCP', 'computer use browser', 'Browserbase alternative', 'Steel browser alternative', 'headless browser detected'. Node (npx) or Python; Windows x64, macOS Intel + Apple Silicon, Linux x64 / arm64. SDK and REST reference is anti-detect-browser; account isolation is multi-account-isolation.

peers.name: multi-account-isolation
peers.description: Verify that browser profiles are actually isolated from one another instead of assuming it - confirm each profile's timezone agrees with its own exit IP, that WebRTC exposes only the proxy, that canvas and WebGL hashes stay identical across relaunches of one profile, and that no two profiles share a persona, a cookie jar, or an address. Use when several of your own accounts or test identities run from one machine and the setup needs checking, when a profile tested clean but something still looks off, when choosing which detection suites to run (CreepJS, whoer, browserleaks WebRTC, pixelscan, liarjs), when auditing what a vendor runtime does with API and proxy credentials, or when asking which layers browser isolation cannot cover at all. Also for 'profile isolation check', 'fingerprint consistency test', 'timezone mismatch', 'WebRTC leak', 'canvas hash unstable', 'account association', 'temporary profile', '防关联', '多账号', '隔离自检'. The SDK is anti-detect-browser; MCP is browser-mcp-agent.

en.tagline: Persistent Chromium profiles with fixed device fingerprints
en.summary: anti-detect-browser lets you drive Chromium through standard Playwright APIs in JavaScript or Python. Each profile keeps one device fingerprint, cookies and storage across runs, and can use its own proxy. It is for keeping separate accounts apart and for testing sites under controlled device and region settings.
problem: Automated browsing often breaks in two ways. Sessions lose their login between runs, or runs share state that should stay separate. Headless browsers also expose contradictions, such as a GPU that does not match the vendor string, which bot checks can flag.
With this skill, each named profile keeps one fingerprint, saved cookies and storage, and an egress IP. Timezone and WebRTC follow that IP. The same profile looks the same on each launch.
fit: Staying logged in across runs for accounts you own
Testing your own site's bot detection with a real-device profile
Checking ads or pricing as seen from another region
Reaching a page as a phone with deviceType 'android'
unfit: Access to accounts or systems you are not authorized to use
Air-gapped environments, since the run-time license exchange cannot be skipped
steps: Create the client with the API key read from an environment variable.
Call launch with a profile name, a fingerprint filter such as Windows 10 and Chrome, and optionally a proxy URL from the environment.
On first use the profile draws a real-device fingerprint and writes it to persona.json; later launches replay it unchanged.
The proxy exit IP is resolved before launch, and timezone and WebRTC are set from it.
You get a standard Playwright browser and page to script as usual.
Profiles created per task can use temporary mode, and you schedule their cleanup yourself.

zh.tagline: 每个配置文件固定一套真实设备指纹的 Chromium
zh.summary: anti-detect-browser 让你用标准 Playwright 接口驱动 Chromium，支持 JavaScript 和 Python。每个配置文件在多次运行之间保留同一套设备指纹、Cookie 和存储，并可绑定自己的代理。适合管理彼此隔离的账号，以及在可控的设备和地区条件下测试网站。
problem: 自动化浏览常见两个问题。会话在两次运行之间丢失登录状态，或者本该分开的运行共用了状态。无头浏览器还会暴露前后矛盾的特征，比如显卡与厂商字符串不一致，容易被机器人检测识别。
使用本技能后，每个命名配置文件保留一套指纹、已保存的 Cookie 和存储，以及一个出口 IP。时区和 WebRTC 跟随该 IP。同一个配置文件每次启动都表现一致。
fit: 为自有账号保持跨次运行的登录状态
用真实设备配置文件测试自己网站的机器人检测
查看另一地区看到的广告或价格
用 deviceType 为 'android' 以手机身份访问页面
unfit: 访问未经授权的账号或系统
无法发起任何出站请求的离线环境，因为运行时的许可交换无法跳过
steps: 从环境变量读取 API 密钥，创建客户端。
调用 launch 时传入配置文件名、指纹筛选条件（如 Windows 10 和 Chrome），以及可选的、来自环境变量的代理地址。
首次使用时，该配置文件抽取一套真实设备指纹并写入 persona.json；之后每次启动原样复用。
启动前解析代理的出口 IP，并据此设置时区和 WebRTC。
得到标准的 Playwright 浏览器和页面，照常编写脚本。
按任务创建的配置文件可使用临时模式，清理时间由你自行安排。
